title: "For you now" block at the top of the solution dashboard
goal: A short block at the very top of the solution dashboard indexes what waits on the owner now, so the owner reads one place first
acceptance: An index, not copies: at most N items (default 8, a documented constant) each linking to its row in "Waiting for the owner" or to its page, and a link to the full section when more exist

Lists decisions waiting on the owner (steps with ownerKind decision, proposals awaiting accept or reject such as gap-review and cross-project-audit proposals), and the owner device, phone and procedure steps with their copy-paste ownerLink pages
Shows the dashboard snapshot age, flagged stale past the existing freshness threshold; an unreadable age reads unknown, never fresh

Built from the data the "Waiting for the owner" section already reads (no second reader); reuses the F-105-T01 cell model for the age state; nothing waiting reads "Nothing waits on you"; a solution with no owner steps keeps its existing output otherwise

Fixture test in tools/test-profiles.mjs committed failing first: decision, proposal, procedure with link, over-cap list, stale and unknown snapshot age, empty case; node tools/solution.mjs check --json carries the same items
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories, manifests and API responses; no personal data, no real alert content.
escalation: A change to how an existing table, gap kind or evidence file behaves goes back to the owner
A source that cannot be read without a new token scope or a project edit is reported unknown, never worked around

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed (about 1.5 to 2 h): a render over rows the Waiting for the owner section already builds, a cap and the age cell, plus fixtures written first. Not a measurement.
